title: Elevators….
content: Elevators in mall world….what are your experiences with them?? I have soooo many dreams where I am running through a mall and I need to take the elevator but it is ALWAYS dangerously broken in some way….is that just me?? The elevators in mall world often make me lucid. “Oh here we go…an elevator…if it is broken, I am in that dream again….”
